audio.time_origin: seconds from start of original untrimmed audio

time_origin: seconds from start of original untrimmed audio

tempo.method: Onset-envelope autocorrelation; pulse-family search restricted to 70–90 BPM based on previous analysis. These windows do not test arbitrary tempo changes.
tempo.note: Small fluctuations and half/double-time readings are not evidence that the song actually accelerates. No beat/downbeat timestamps are supplied by this file.

normalization.relative_energy: 3-second-scale smoothed RMS in dB, clipped/scaled to within-song 5th–95th percentiles; not LUFS or calibrated perceived loudness
normalization.rhythmic_activity: Smoothed positive spectral change across 64 log-frequency bands, scaled within song; busy/attack-rich texture proxy, not BPM or an isolated drum measure
normalization.brightness: Smoothed spectral centroid scaled within song; not emotional brightness
normalization.visual_intensity_hint: Optional design heuristic: 0.55*relative_energy + 0.45*rhythmic_activity; not measured emotional intensity

manual_annotation_example.note: Example schema only; not an annotation of this song.
